source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Taking the place of the further clinical assessment the stroke team would otherwise still need to perform at the bedside","B":"Applying mainly to clients who have already been formally diagnosed with a stroke prior to the code being called","C":"Deliberately delaying care until a complete diagnostic workup has been fully finished before any treatment begins","D":"Mobilize a rapid, coordinated team response, including prompt imaging and evaluation, given the critical importance of timely treatment"}}
source_row.rationale: Stroke code activation is intended to mobilize a rapid, coordinated team response, including prompt imaging and evaluation, given the critical time-sensitivity of stroke treatment.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Rapid Stroke Response Activation
